description: Per-frame overrides for the DISP-CAL algorithm (Venti plan T27). plate: ITRF2020-PMM plate for the plate_motion layer (PRD D3: NA default, PA Hawaii, CA Puerto Rico; California stays NA). tropo.mode: from the trade studies (tropo_check). uncertainty.k_grid: per frame from TS-G1 (2026-10-09, disp2vlm_validation studies/TS-G1/REPORT.md: std fit of grid-vs-MIDAS LOS velocity residuals on a held-out 30% station split, UNR constant grid v0.3 IGS20); default 3.9 (the earlier F08882 placeholder) for frames without a fit. benchmark_category: PRD section 2.7. Values here are consumed once the T34/T35/T37 code paths land; with schema-v2 defaults they change nothing.
